title: Rune Mysteries (historical)
start: Lumbridge Castle. Go to the floor 2 and talk to Duke Horacio.

recommended.t: Varrock Teleport spells would make the journey considerably faster

rewards.t: Access to the Rune essence mine (mage NPC's like Sedridor and Aubury can teleport you there). The most common rune essence mine teleport is Aubury's in Varrock.
Two extra spins on the Squeal of Fortune

steps.t: Look for the wizard Sedridor in the basement and then talk to him. He will confirm to be the head wizard and take the talisman given by Duke Horacio before giving you a research package, which you have to deliver to rune expert Aubury in Varrock. Aubury lives south of Varrock's east bank where he has his own Rune Shop.

Getting there: From the Wizards' Tower, you can use the Varrock Teleport to greatly shorten the trip, as it is a long walk from the Tower to Varrock. Alternatively, you can use the Lumbridge Teleport, then use a canoe to Varrock, (if you have a level 12 woodcutting).

Go to Aubury's Rune Shop and talk to Aubury. He'll want you to deliver some notes back to Wizard Sedridor and also ask you if you would like to be teleported directly to the Wizards' Tower. This teleport will bring you outside the Wizards' Tower. (He sometimes will not ask)
After giving the notes to Wizard Sedridor, he will give you an air talisman and he'll explain the Runecrafting skill. Congratulations, quest complete!
